title: IITM storyboard
description: Machine-readable scene timeline for one question's short(s). Consumed by the shared scene runtime (_runtime/hic-scenes.js) and the render pipeline. Timings are integer milliseconds; beats must tile [0, total_duration_ms] without gaps or overlaps.

id.description: Question id; must match index.md frontmatter id

aspect.description: Stage aspect; runtime maps this to the stage box via hic-frame-compatible dims

background.description: CSS color/paint for the stage; defaults #0e1512

start_ms.description: Exclusive lower bound of the scene; scene 0 must start at 0

end_ms.description: Exclusive upper bound; last scene's end_ms must equal total_duration_ms; scenes must not overlap; gaps allowed (nothing visible in a gap)

fade_out_ms.description: Soft-cut: fade the whole scene out over its final N ms (scene-local)

id.description: Unique within the storyboard; becomes the DOM id

text.description: text/latex/answer content. text: plain; latex: $..$/$$..$$; answer: final value

of.description: shape only: id of the element to overlay (highlight/underline geometry)

shape.description: shape type; 'highlight' = animated border box like the original #highlight-box

at_ms.description: Element-local timeline origin (defaults to 0 = scene start)

loop.description: text only: 900ms blink loop while visible

anim.description: Staged animation phase: pop = overshoot scale-in; fade = opacity only; slide = fade+translate. Times are relative to at_ms.

from_x.description: slide: x-offset px at start (e.g. -30 enters from left)

from_y.description: slide: y-offset px at start (e.g. 50 enters from below)

overshoot.description: pop: spring constant s in ease-back

stagger_ms.description: cards only: per-item delay added to each successive card's in.start_ms
